mapper.select: select count(1) from cms_topic t where t.club_id = #{clubId} and t.del_flag = 0 and t.status = 1 and ifnull(t.is_settlement, 0) = 0

select distinct s.id, coalesce(s.topic_id, o.topic_id) as topicId, s.amount, case when s.line_type = 'LEAD_FEE' and o.to_type = 'club' and o.to_id = #{clubId} then 'incoming' when s.payee_type = 'initiator' and exists (select 1 from cms_topic direction_topic where direction_topic.id = s.topic_id and direction_topic.club_id = #{clubId}) then 'incoming' when s.payee_type in ('platform', 'club', 'merchant') and exists (select 1 from cms_topic direction_topic where direction_topic.id = s.topic_id and direction_topic.club_id = #{clubId}) then 'outgoing' else 'unknown' end as direction from coop_settlement s left join coop_order o on o.id = s.coop_order_id where s.del_flag = 0 and s.status = 0 and (s.amount is null or s.amount > 0) and ( exists ( select 1 from cms_topic t where t.id = s.topic_id and t.club_id = #{clubId} ) or ( s.line_type = 'LEAD_FEE' and o.to_type = 'club' and o.to_id = #{clubId} ) ) order by s.id

select count(1) from coop_order o where o.status = 0 and o.del_flag = 0 and ( (o.to_type = 'club' and o.to_id = #{clubId}) or exists ( select 1 from cms_topic t where t.id = o.topic_id and t.club_id = #{clubId} ) ) and ( o.topic_id is null or not exists (select 1 from cms_topic parent where parent.id = o.topic_id) or exists ( select 1 from cms_topic parent where parent.id = o.topic_id and ifnull(parent.is_settlement, 0) = 0 ) )

select count(1) from coop_order o where o.to_type = 'club' and o.to_id = #{clubId} and o.status = 0 and o.del_flag = 0 and ( o.topic_id is null or not exists (select 1 from cms_topic parent where parent.id = o.topic_id) )

select distinct i.id, i.topic_id as topicId, i.deposit_status as depositStatus, i.deposit_amount as amount, case when i.del_flag = 0 and ( (i.deposit_status = 4 and i.invite_type in (0,1)) or (i.deposit_status = 2 and ( i.status = 3 or exists ( select 1 from cms_topic refund_topic where refund_topic.id = i.topic_id and refund_topic.is_settlement = 1 ) ))) then 1 else 0 end as retryable from coop_invite i where (i.deposit_status in (1, 2, 5) or (i.deposit_status = 4 and not ( coalesce(i.deposit_refund_state,'') = 'SUCCESS' and i.deposit_refund_confirmed_at is not null and trim(coalesce(i.deposit_out_trade_no,'')) != '' and coalesce(i.deposit_refund_no,'') = concat('R',coalesce(i.deposit_out_trade_no,'')) ))) and ( (i.to_type = 'club' and i.to_id = #{clubId}) or exists ( select 1 from cms_topic t where t.id = i.topic_id and t.club_id = #{clubId} ) ) order by i.id

select count(1) from cms_activity a where a.del_flag = 0 and a.status = 1 and a.publish_status = 1 and a.cancel_time is null and (a.end_date is null or a.end_date > now()) and ( a.club_id = #{clubId} or exists ( select 1 from cms_topic t where t.id = a.topic_id and t.club_id = #{clubId} ) )

select count(1) from cms_registration r where ( (r.owner_type = 1 and exists ( select 1 from cms_topic t where t.id = r.owner_id and t.club_id = #{clubId} )) or (r.owner_type = 2 and exists ( select 1 from cms_activity a where a.id = r.owner_id and ( a.club_id = #{clubId} or exists ( select 1 from cms_topic t2 where t2.id = a.topic_id and t2.club_id = #{clubId} ) ) )) ) and case when r.registration_status = 3 and r.payment_status in (3, 4) then 0 when r.registration_status = 4 and r.payment_status = 3 then 0 when r.registration_status = 2 and r.payment_status = 2 and ifnull(r.verification_status, 0) = 1 and ( (r.purchase_kind is not null and r.purchase_kind != 3) or not exists ( select 1 from registration_entitlement entitlement where entitlement.registration_id = r.id and entitlement.status = 0 ) ) then 0 else 1 end = 1
